about: LinkKind as integers, which are this crate's own definition and a wire contract (R13, R59). The set is derived from the two directions a measurement chain can run: a physical event becoming a number (acquisition, 1 to 10, in order) and a command becoming a physical event (stimulus, 11 to 16, in order), plus the two stages that apply to either (17 and 18). A chain omits the stages it does not have. A link kind is written to a record as its integer, so no value is renumbered or reused, and a new stage is a reviewed addition appended with the next integer. Row names are the variant names in snake case. A face that renumbers, or appends in another order, fails a row.
